content.subject: Apparel fulfillment expansion and headcount
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,

ShipMonk opened an apparel-specific fulfillment center to reduce returns and SKU complexity. Operational expansion drives headcount growth proportional to transaction volume across similar fulfillment launches.

We build bots that reconcile inventory movements without manual entry for each transaction.

Can we schedule a brief call next week to explore if this fits your roadmap and see if it aligns with your cost targets?
Zamp
